meta.name: exa-search
meta.description: Web toolkit powered by Exa, tuned for scientific and technical content. Use this skill when the user needs to search the web or fetch/extract URL content. Covers: web search (semantic lookups, research, current info — with optional research-paper category and academic domain filtering) and URL extraction (fetching pages, articles, academic PDFs in batch). Use this skill for web-related tasks when the user wants high-quality search or scholarly filtering via category=research paper. Triggers on requests to search, look up, fetch a page, or extract an article.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搜索学术网页并提取内容
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要搜索学术资料或批量提取网页内容。
copy.tagline_en: Search academic web and extract content
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to search scholarly sources or batch-extract web content.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以用 Exa 搜索网络或提取网页内容，特别擅长查找科学、技术类资料。它会优先使用学术来源，并在引用时标注作者和年份。
howto.when: 当你要求搜索、查询信息、获取某个网页或文章内容时触发。如果话题是科学或技术类，它会自动偏向学术论文。

say.text: 帮我搜索最新的量子计算研究论文。
say.note: Claude 会用 Exa 搜索并优先返回学术论文。

say.text: 查找关于 CRISPR 基因编辑的近期文章。
say.note: Claude 会搜索网络并偏向学术来源。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can search the web or extract URL content using Exa, optimized for scientific and technical topics. It prioritizes academic sources and cites authors and years when available.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to search, look up, fetch a page, or extract an article. For scientific/technical queries, it automatically biases toward scholarly sources.

say_en.text: Search for the latest research papers on quantum computing.
say_en.note: Claude will use Exa to search and prioritize academic papers.

say_en.text: Extract the abstract of this paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.12345
say_en.note: Claude will fetch the URL and extract the abstract.

say_en.text: Find recent articles about CRISPR gene editing.
say_en.note: Claude will search the web with a bias toward academic sources.
